# Runtime dependencies

This directory is reserved for explicitly integrated upstream source checkouts, such as the pinned official DINOv3 training implementation. No runtime dependency has been installed here yet.

Local checkouts are excluded from Git. Record upstream URLs, pinned revisions, configuration overrides and licenses when integration begins. Model weights belong under the NAS `resources/pretrained/` directory. The local `reference/` directory is separate and entirely excluded from Git.
